BSMARTISH
Mid-Term Rentals & Real Estate Developer based in Porto, Portugal. Fully furnished serviced apartments for stays from 1 to 12 months, and urban renovation projects developed both independently and in partnership with investors, since 2006.
About
BSMARTISH is an urban renovation and mid-term rental developer operating in Porto, Portugal (originally founded in Spain, in 2006, relocated to Porto in 2017). The company develops, renovates and operates its own real estate assets, offering fully furnished, serviced apartments for mid-term rental (1 to 12 months), and also partners with investors to develop tailored urban renovation projects — from acquisition and concept design through to execution and monetisation.
BSMARTISH mid-term rentals are best suited for: professionals relocating to Porto, digital nomads, students, expatriates.
Additionally, our urban renovation expertise can be for the best interest of investors interested in urban renovation projects in Porto.
Services

* Mid-Term Rentals: Fully furnished, serviced apartments in Porto for stays from 1 to 12 months. Includes fortnightly cleaning and utilities up to €150/month.
* Third-Party Project Management & Consultancy: BSMARTISH partners with investors to deliver tailored real estate projects in Porto, from acquisition and concept design through to execution and monetisation.

Available Apartments

* [Paranhos Apartment](https://www.bsmartish.com/mid-term-rentals-in-porto/paranhos-apartment): 1-bedroom, 60m², Paranhos, Porto. University area with direct access to city centre.
* [Matosinhos Apartment](https://www.bsmartish.com/mid-term-rentals-in-porto/matosinhos-apartment): 2-bedroom, 155m², Matosinhos, Porto. Premium location, near beach and city centre.
* [Alegria Apartment](https://www.bsmartish.com/mid-term-rentals-in-porto/alegria-apartment): 1-bedroom, 44m², Porto city centre. Soundproof double-glazed windows.
